summary: This NEI Center Core Grant for Vision Research aims to study the structure, development, and function of the visual system in health and disease, with the goal of preventing or curing blinding diseases. Four resource and service Cores will facilitate this objective: the Image Analysis and Graphics Core, which includes morphometric analysis and imaging techniques such as OCT, fundus photography, and slit-lamp examination; the Morphology Core, which involves histology, ocular imaging, and visual functional testing; the Computer/IT Core, which provides programming and support for data analysis and storage; and the Rapid-Prototyping and Design Core, which designs new research equipment and educates users. The grant supports a community of 41 vision scientists at UCSF, including 20 with NEI-supported grants, 5 with other NIH funding, and 7 with private funding.
